title: Read plan for the M365 driver bridge
description: Hub candidate. A list of read-only operations a driver (connector, graph or fixture) executes verbatim. op_id is the first 16 hex of sha256 of the canonical {op, args}, so re-planning the same operation gives the same id. The receipt echoes the sha256 of the canonical {created, ops}, so a receipt cannot be replayed against a later plan. file.get is reserved for the Graph driver: the connector cannot report who uploaded a file.
